youtube.title: Who invented the stethoscope? A shy doctor and a sheet of paper 🩺
youtube.description:
Germany, England or the third one? Two centuries ago doctors listened to a heart by pressing an ear to the chest. One young physician, embarrassed in front of a female patient, rolled a sheet of paper into a tube — and heard the heartbeat more clearly than ever. He named it from the Greek, wrote the book, and died of the very disease his tube diagnosed best.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the hospital, the old method wiped away, and the two dates that made the instrument.
Which did you pick?
